subject: Evidence: SDLC controls — PR gating, CI logs, and secrets rotation
messages:
From: Philip Turner <philip.turner@acmefin.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acmefin.com
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: follow-up — SDLC evidence request (PR gating, secrets)

Hi Rachel / Marissa,

Thanks for the product demo last week. Our assessor team is working through the SIG questionnaire and has asked for concrete evidence around your Secure SDLC controls. Specifically we need:

- The PR gating policy (who approves, required checks)
- Recent CI run logs demonstrating gate enforcement
- Secrets management and rotation evidence (rotation cadence, auditing)
- Change management approvals for production-impacting changes

I've attached a spreadsheet with the specific SIG rows we need filled (column E notes). If you can upload artifacts or give links to a shared drive it will speed up the review.

Can you confirm an ETA for a first tranche of artifacts? We are aiming to close this section by 2027-09-20.

Thanks,
Philip Turner
Senior IT Risk Manager
Acme Financial
(attachment: SIG-questionnaire-requests.xlsx)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Philip Turner <philip.turner@acmefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: follow-up — SDLC evidence request (PR gating, secrets)

Hi Philip —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide an initial bundle by EOD 2027-09-14 with the items below and then follow up with deeper CI artifacts if you need more context. Quick summary of what we'll include:

- PR gating policy doc (PDF) describing required approvers, protected branches, and automated checks.
- Export of three recent CI job runs showing failed PRs blocked by lint/tests/secrets-scan.
- Secrets rotation audit CSV with rotation timestamps for application key material over the last 12 months.
- Summary note on emergency change approvals (change advisory procedure + ticket refs).

Links to the shared folder and the CI job are below; I will also attach the policy PDF to this thread. If the assessor needs specific job IDs, Vivek will attach the pipeline logs.

Related links: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/SDLC-evidence/ACM-SIG-202709
CI example: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/42013

We'll mark each attachment with the SIG row numbers so your team can match artifacts to questions.

Rachel Kim
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Philip Turner <philip.turner@acmefin.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: follow-up — PR gating details and evidence

Philip — adding the gating specifics and one example screenshot. Key points:

- Branch protection: main and release branches are protected; force pushes disabled.
- PR approvals: minimum 2 approvers for merge to protected branches. At least one approver must be from the owning service team.
- Automated checks: every PR triggers the CI pipeline that runs unit tests, integration smoke tests, linter, and a secrets-scan (git-secrets + pre-commit hooks). Failing checks prevent merge.
- Merge policy: merges require green CI + required approvals, enforced by platform (no manual bypass).

Attachment: pr-gating-policy.pdf (includes annotated screenshots of GitHub branch protection and required checks).

Short example of a blocked PR we will include in the bundle:
- PR #1287: blocked due to discovered secret in commit message; author remediated and provided remediation comment.

Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
(attachment: pr-gating-policy.pdf)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Philip Turner <philip.turner@acmefin.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: CI evidence and secrets rotation details

Philip — attaching the CI job export and the secrets rotation audit CSV for the last 12 months. Notes:

- CI evidence: we've exported the pipeline runs for the three most recent PRs that hit protected branches (job IDs 42013, 41987, 41840). The archive contains build logs, which show the secrets-scan step (git-secrets) failing where relevant and blocking merges.
- Secrets rotation: we rotate application credentials quarterly by default; critical keys (production-signing, DB master) are rotated every 90 days and recorded in the rotation audit. Rotation operations are executed via our KMS + automated rotation jobs; keys are stored in a customer-segregated vault for Dedicated/private customers.
- Auditability: rotation events are logged to our audit log (immutable) and available for 13 months via the audit retrieval API.
- Change approvals: production-impacting changes require either an approved RFC in the changelog system or an emergency CAB approval; we included two recent RFC IDs in the attached CSV for reference.

Attachments: cicd-job-logs-202708.zip, secrets-rotation-audit-2027Q3.csv

If the assessor needs signed attestations for the rotation schedule or HSM/KMS configuration, let me know and I will escalate to our security architecture team for a short note.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Security
Redwood Inference
(attachments: cicd-job-logs-202708.zip; secrets-rotation-audit-2027Q3.csv)

From: SIG Assessor <auditor-requests@sig-assessor.org>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Philip Turner <philip.turner@acmefin.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: follow-up — SDLC evidence request (PR gating, secrets)

Rachel / Vivek / Marissa —

Thanks for the artifacts; we received the ZIP and CSV and will start mapping to SIG rows. Quick clarification: the SIG assessment needs confirmation on log retention for CI job logs — the control requires at least 12 months of immutable build logs. Your note mentions 13 months; can you confirm that the CI job logs archive is immutable for 13 months and provide the retention policy reference?

If you can drop that reference into the shared drive folder with a short pointer to the specific policy paragraph, we should be able to close that control.

Regards,
SIG Assessment Team
(Please upload any additional files to: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/SDLC-evidence/ACM-SIG-202709)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: SIG Assessor <auditor-requests@sig-assessor.org>, Philip Turner <philip.turner@acmefin.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: follow-up — SDLC evidence request (PR gating, secrets)

Confirmed — the CI job logs are retained as immutable audit artifacts for 13 months (policy section 4.2.1: "Build and pipeline logs retention") and are stored in our tamper-evident archive. I uploaded the retention policy excerpt and a short attestation to the shared folder (file: ci-log-retention-policy-excerpt.pdf). The link is in the folder you already have access to.

Let me know if you need anything else; we aim to have this SIG section closed by 2027-09-20.

Rachel
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: ci-log-retention-policy-excerpt.pdf)
